Name: Raven's Mystery Box Exchanger
Author: Ravenhyde
TagLine: A craftable machine that allows you to exchane Mystery Boxes for (mostly) Community Center bundle items.
Description:
Tired of hauling Mystery Boxes to Clint's just to get something useless? Need to complete the Community Center or Lost bundles? This mod may be for you!

This Content Patcher mod introduces a new craftable machine into the game. It can be fed a Mystery Box and will return an item that can be used for the Community Center or Lost bundles (so you could get wood... or you could end up with a Prismatic Shard) or a small subset of the regular Mystery Box list (such as a Warp Totem: Farm or a Pearl). This machine requires 1 Prize Ticket and 6 Mystery Boxes to craft and is available at the start of the game.

Note: This machine only takes Mystery Boxes, not the Golden variant. It is not set up to include items from other mods.
